headline: Copper Sinks Over 20% to Enter Bear Market Amid AI and Demand Concerns
summary: Copper prices plunged to their lowest level since late 2025 on the London Metal Exchange, dropping over 20% from September highs to enter a bear market amid AI spending doubts and weak Chinese demand.
why: Industrial metal price declines signal broader economic slowdowns in manufacturing and construction, impacting mining company revenues and commodity-linked currencies.

impacts.name: Copper
impacts.why: Falling demand expectations and macroeconomic headwinds drive industrial metal prices into bear market territory.
impacts.baseline_rule: first recorded price at or after created_at (15-minute price recorder); end = first price at least 24 h later, within 48 h

why_moved: Fears over artificial intelligence spending deceleration, potential Federal Reserve rate hikes, and sluggish industrial demand in China triggered aggressive liquidations in copper futures.
